HV Cable Jointer

LSP Renewables

TBC
Wind & Renewables Offshore Windfarm United Kingdom, Europe North Sea Temporary Boarding: 19/11/2026
Posted yesterday #JWjEA6c1

Requirements

Show all vacancies
Candidates must have experience in HV cable pulling, routing, and clipping, as well as connecting HV tower cables into junction boxes. Experience with HV cable termination within WTG nacelles and installation/removal of HV jumper cables is essential. Familiarity with Pfisterer Seaanex Type 3a systems and working under Permit-to-Work and Electrical Safety Rules is required. Candidates should be able to support wider WTG commissioning activities and work as part of an experienced offshore commissioning team.

About This Opportunity

LSP Renewables is hiring a HV Cable Jointer for operations aboard Offshore Windfarm class vessels based in United Kingdom, Europe, covering the North Sea operating area. This is a temporary position, with boarding scheduled for 19/11/2026.
